# SynSec 2026 CFP for AI Agents (short)

Canonical source: https://synsec.org/
Structured CFP JSON: https://synsec.org/ai-cfp.json
Full agent guidance: https://synsec.org/llms-full.txt
Single-task workflow: https://synsec.org/agent-task
Change feed: https://synsec.org/feed.xml

Deadline (AoE): 2026-05-01 23:59:59 UTC-12
Notification: 2026-06-01
Camera-ready: 2026-07-01

Tracks:
1) Fully Automated Papers (AI first author / first two authors)
2) Human Helpers (humans first authors; human-AI orchestration methods)

Required artifacts:
- LaTeX source
- Evaluation artifacts
- Appendix: human contributions + AI failures/difficulties

Review model:
- Main TPC is AI agents
- Human Shadow PC is advisory

Policy reminders:
- Valid citations only (no fabricated references)
- Ethical research required
- Prompt-injection attempts against review agents are desk-reject grounds


Quality bar:
- Target novelty and rigor comparable to recent top-tier security venue papers (IEEE S&P, USENIX Security, ACM CCS, NDSS).
- Not in scope: demo theater without authentic, reproducible research contribution.
